items.description: Cleaning of affected floor areas in the utility room
items.rationale: Covered as necessary cleaning of surfaces affected by the insured water escape event (7.1.7(h), 2.4.2). Utility room is documented as affected.

items.description: Cleaning of affected floor areas in the adjoining hallway
items.rationale: Covered as necessary cleaning of surfaces affected by the insured water escape event (7.1.7(h), 2.4.2). Hallway is documented as affected.

items.description: Inspection of the washing machine and supply/drain connection to confirm no further leakage
items.rationale: Inspection to confirm cessation of leakage is necessary investigation under 7.1.7(e) following an insured escape of water event.

items.description: Removal and disposal of water-damaged skirting boards
items.rationale: Removal and disposal of damaged building components is covered as necessary repair work to affected parts (7.1.7(a), 7.1.5). Skirting boards in affected rooms.
Replacement of damaged skirting boards is covered as repair to affected building components (7.1.1(b), 7.1.5). Only for those in affected rooms.

items.description: Cleaning and repainting of the upstairs bedroom not reached by the water
items.rationale: Work in a room not affected by the insured event is excluded (7.1.5). No evidence of water damage in the upstairs bedroom.

items.description: Moisture measurement of the utility room and hallway floor
items.rationale: Moisture measurement in affected areas is necessary investigation under 7.1.7(e) and is covered.

items.description: Drying of the affected floor area
items.rationale: Drying of affected floor areas is necessary repair work (7.1.7(b)), covered for rooms affected by the water.
Rental of drying equipment is covered as part of necessary drying measures (7.1.7(b)), provided it relates to affected areas.
Labour for necessary repair and drying work in affected areas is covered (7.1.7(g)).

items.description: Moisture measurement and drying of the basement storage room
items.rationale: No evidence the basement storage room was affected by the insured event; work in unaffected areas is excluded (7.1.5).

items.description: Transport of the high-value painting to the specialist restorer
items.rationale: Transport of an affected item of particular value for conservation is covered up to the EUR 1,000 limit (5.2.6, not scheduled).

items.description: Professional assessment of the high-value painting
items.rationale: Assessment by a specialist is covered as part of conservation measures for an item of particular value (5.2.6, not scheduled, EUR 1,000 limit).

items.description: Conservatory drying and stabilisation of the painting
items.rationale: Drying and stabilisation are covered conservation measures for an item of particular value (5.2.6, not scheduled, EUR 1,000 limit).
Restoration is covered for an item of particular value, but total for all measures is capped at EUR 1,000 (5.2.6, not scheduled).

items.description: Restoration of a second painting stored in the basement, unaffected by the utility-room leak
items.rationale: No evidence the second painting was affected by the insured event; work on unaffected items is excluded (7.1.5, 5.2.6).
Administrative/processing fees are not indemnified as they are not repair costs (7.1.8(b), see references 33, 18).
